# Blink Pay Button (vendored)

`blink-pay-button.js` is an unmodified copy of Blink's donate button, version 1.5.3,
from https://github.com/blinkbitcoin/donation-button.blink.sv at commit `5b4a7919ee6e`
(file `js/blink-pay-button.js`). It is licensed under the GNU AGPL-3.0; source and
license: https://github.com/blinkbitcoin/donation-button.blink.sv

It is served from this site so an upstream change can't alter our donate page.
To update: copy the file from a newer commit, review the diff, and change the commit above.
